subject: Mathematics
source_note: TIE (2023), Mathematics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

sub_topics.title: Use rates and variations in different contexts
competences: (a) Describe the concepts of rates and variations
(b) Solve problems on rates and variations

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concepts of rates and variations
objectives.resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, charts of real life scenarios, graph papers, rates and variation animations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts of rates and variations are well described

objectives.text: (b) Solve problems on rates and variations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Problems on rates and variations are correctly solved

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra

sub_topics.title: Use geometry, approximations, relations and functions in various contexts
competences: (a) Describe the concepts of geometry (similarities and congruence)
(b) Recognize properties of similar triangles
(c) Explain postulates, proofs, and theorems of congruent triangles

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concepts of geometry (similarities and congruence)
objectives.resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, graph papers, geometrical figures animations, congruence and similarities simulations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts of geometry are well described

objectives.text: (b) Recognize properties of similar triangles
objectives.assessment_criteria: Properties of similar triangles are clearly recognized

objectives.text: (c) Explain postulates, proofs, and theorems of congruent triangles
objectives.assessment_criteria: Postulates, proofs, and theorems of congruent triangles are clearly explained

sub_topics.title: Use algebra and matrices in problem solving
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of algebra (binary operations, quadratic expressions and equations, radicals, exponents, and logarithms)
(b) Solve quadratic equations by using different methods (factorisation, Completing the square, and quadratic formula)
(c) Identify and use laws of exponents involving positive, negative, and zero exponents (multiplication law, division law, power law, and zero index)
(d) Write numbers in standard form
(e) Use laws of logarithms to solve problems
(f) Perform operations on radicals and rationalize the denominators

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of algebra (binary operations, quadratic expressions and equations, radicals, exponents, and logarithms)
objectives.teaching_methods: Jigsaw, Graphical methods, Use of technology, Problems solving
objectives.resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, Mathematical software such as GeoGebra, MATLAB, Maple, Mathematica, graphing calculators
objectives.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of algebra are explored correctly

objectives.text: (b) Solve quadratic equations by using different methods (factorisation, Completing the square, and quadratic formula)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Quadratic equations are solved correctly

objectives.text: (c) Identify and use laws of exponents involving positive, negative, and zero exponents (multiplication law, division law, power law, and zero index)
objectives.resources: Exponent games and applications, exponent puzzles, exponent rule posters, visual aids, exponent animations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Laws of exponents are clearly identified and used correctly

objectives.text: (d) Write numbers in standard form
objectives.resources: Calculators, number charts, exponent games and applications, exponent puzzles, exponent rule posters, visual aids, exponent animations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Numbers are correctly written in standard form

objectives.text: (e) Use laws of logarithms to solve problems
objectives.assessment_criteria: Laws of logarithms are used to solve problems correctly

objectives.text: (f) Perform operations on radicals and rationalize the denominators
objectives.assessment_criteria: Operations on radicals and denominators are clearly performed

sub_topics.title: Use sets, sequences and series in problem solving
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of sets (types of sets, subsets, operation with sets, and Venn diagrams of two sets)
(b) Distinguish among different types of sets (universal set, equal sets, empty/null set, finite and infinite sets, equivalent sets, and disjoint sets)
(c) Compare sets (subsets and universal sets)
(d) Perform operations with sets (union, intersection, and complement of a set)
(e) Represent two sets in a Venn diagram
(f) Find the number of elements in a set

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of sets (types of sets, subsets, operation with sets, and Venn diagrams of two sets)
objectives.resources: Real objects, set simulations, charts of different sets, playing cards, coloured chalks
objectives.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of sets are clearly explored

objectives.text: (b) Distinguish among different types of sets (universal set, equal sets, empty/null set, finite and infinite sets, equivalent sets, and disjoint sets)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Different types of sets are clearly distinguished

objectives.text: (c) Compare sets (subsets and universal sets)
objectives.resources: Real objects, set simulations, charts of different sets, playing cards, coloured chalks
objectives.assessment_criteria: Sets are clearly compared

objectives.text: (d) Perform operations with sets (union, intersection, and complement of a set)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Operations with sets are correctly performed

objectives.text: (e) Represent two sets in a Venn diagram
objectives.assessment_criteria: Sets in a Venn diagram are correctly represented

objectives.text: (f) Find the number of elements in a set
objectives.assessment_criteria: Number of elements in a set are correctly found

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in coordinate geometry, trigonometry, circles, vectors, probability, and statistics

sub_topics.title: Use basic coordinate geometry, trigonometry and vectors skills in daily life
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of trigonometry (trigonometric ratios, angles of elevation and depression)
(b) Determine trigonometric ratios of angles and special angles
(c) Calculate angles of elevation and depression

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of trigonometry (trigonometric ratios, angles of elevation and depression)
objectives.resources: Geometry animations, Mathematical software such as GeoGebra, MATLAB, Maple, Mathematica, graph paper, mathematical set
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of trigonometry are clearly explored

objectives.text: (b) Determine trigonometric ratios of angles and special angles
objectives.assessment_criteria: Trigonometric ratios of angles and special angles are clearly determined

objectives.text: (c) Calculate angles of elevation and depression
objectives.assessment_criteria: Angles of elevation and depression are calculated correctly
